### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[A]: Do not infer specific diagnoses (e.g., disc herniation, degenerative disc disease) unless explicitly stated by the provider. Report only confirmed diagnoses or stated differential diagnoses.
[P]: Include only explicit, actionable treatment or follow-up steps as part of the plan. Do not include general conversational interactions (e.g., asking about questions) as formal plan items.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[A]: Do not conclude the absence of conditions (e.g., "no underlying conditions identified") if diagnostic tests (e.g., blood work, imaging) have been explicitly ordered to investigate or rule out those conditions.
